📢TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Whitbourne RCMP is currently responding to a tractor trailer blocking both directions of the Trans-Canada Highway between Bellevue and Chance Cove.

🚧 As the TCH is impassable at this time, traffic is being diverted onto the Bellevue and Chance Cove exits. Motorists should expect delays and are asked to continue to drive with extreme caution and obey all directions from police. 

⚠️ Road conditions and visibility in the areas surrounding Whitbourne, including along the Trans-Canada Highway between Hodgewater Line and Whitbourne, and along the Veterans Memorial Highway (Route 75) are deteriorating once again.

Please consider delaying any non-essential travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and drive according to road and weather conditions. 

Remember, snow means slow!

#nltraffic
